αἰδῶ: αἰδώς — shame, a sense of respect or reserve; fem. acc. sg., subject of an infinitive
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg.: ’himself’, reinforcing a personal pronoun (σοὶ δ’ αὐτῷ ’to you yourself’) · also used alone as a plain personal pronoun, ’him’, not reinforcing anything (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ μηχανόωνται ’are plotting against him’) · also with a noun, ’own, very’, in the dat. of accompaniment: αὐτῷ φάρει ’with the cloak itself, cloak and all’ · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοὶ αὐτῷ) · also plain pronoun of a thing, ’it’, after a preposition (ἀμφ’ αὐτῷ ’around it’)
βασιλῆας: βασιλεύς — king, chief; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -εῖς)
βουλῇ: βουλή — plan, counsel, council; fem. dat. sg. (ἐνὶ βουλῇ ’in council’)
βοῶν: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; gen. pl.
βροτὸν: βροτός — mortal; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with ἄνδρα ’a mortal man’)
γέλασσαν: γελάω — laugh; aor. 3 pl. act., epic -σσ- and unaugmented (= ἐγέλασαν)
γέρα: γέρας — prize of honor, honorific portion; neut. acc. pl. (γέρα)
γυναῖκες: γυνή — woman; fem. nom. pl., in apposition to δμωαί: ’women’ · also fem. nom. pl. in a pair: ’women’ (ἀνέρες ἠδὲ γυναῖκες ’men and women’) · also fem. nom. pl., plain subject: ’the women’ (of a household)
δήμου: δῆμος — people, community (also the land of a people); masc. gen. sg.
δήσας: δέω — bind, tie; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having tied’
δαιμόνι: δαιμόνιος — strange, puzzling, odd (a voc. of address; the force, gentle or chiding, is uncertain); masc. voc. sg., elided (δαιμόνι’ = δαιμόνιε)
διδοῦσιν: δίδωμι — give; pres. 3 pl. (= Attic διδόασι)
εἴην: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 1 sg.: ’I would be’ · also pres. opt. 1 sg. in a wish after αἲ γάρ: ’would that I were’
εἴπεσκεν: εἶπον — say, speak; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic (Attic εἶπε): ’would say, used to say’
εἵματα: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: εἵματα γάρ ῥ’ ἐβάρυνε ’for the clothes weighed him down’
εὐρυβάτης: Εὐρυβάτης — Eurybates, Odysseus’ herald (’wide-strider’); masc. nom. sg.
θέειν: θέω — run; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic θεῖν)
θήν: θήν — surely, indeed; epic enclitic particle (= Attic δήπου)
θαλερὸν: θαλερός — blooming, vigorous, swelling; adj., neut. acc. sg. (θαλερὸν δάκρυ ’a swelling tear’) · also masc. acc. sg. (θαλερὸν γάμον ’a flourishing marriage’)
κεκλημένος: καλέω — call, name; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’called’ (not κλίνω, cf. κεκλιμένη)
κερτομέων: κερτομέω — taunt, mock, jeer at; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (+ acc.)
κιχήσομαι: κιχάνω — come upon, find, reach; fut. 1 sg. mid., epic: ’I shall find’
κιχείη: κιχάνω — reach, overtake, come upon; aor. opt. 3 sg., athematic (ἔκιχον, κιχείην), in a wish: ’may it overtake’
κοίρανος: κοίρανος — ruler, commander; masc. nom. sg.
κρόνου: Κρόνος — Cronus, father of Zeus; masc. gen. sg.: Κρόνου πάϊς ’son of Cronus’ is Zeus
κόμισσε: κομίζω — take care of, tend, look after; aor. 3 sg., epic σσ (= ἐκόμισε), unaugmented
κόσμον: κόσμος — order, arrangement, due order; masc. acc. sg. (οὐ κατὰ κόσμον ’not in due order’)
λαβὼν: λαμβάνω — take, take hold of; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’ (γούνων λαβών ’clasping the knees’, gen. of the part grasped)
λαούς: λαός — people, men; masc. acc. pl.
μάλιστ: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα, elided (μάλιστ’ = μάλιστα): ’most of all, especially’
μάψ: μάψ — rashly, in vain, without due cause; adv.
μετάφρενον: μετάφρενον — the back (between the shoulders); neut. acc. sg.
μηκέτ: μηκέτι — no longer, no more; adv., elided (μηκέτ’ = μηκέτι)
μοῦνος: μόνος (epic/Ionic μοῦνος) — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
νέην: νέος — young; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with νύμφην
νείκεε: νεικέω — quarrel with, chide, blame; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νείκει), with μή: ’do not blame’
νεικείων: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic νεικῶν)
οἴκαδέ: οἴκαδε — homeward, to one’s home; adv. (οἶκος + -δε)
οἴσει: φέρω — bear, carry, bring; fut. 3 sg. (fut. οἴσω): ’will carry’
οἶσθ: οἶδα — know; perf. 2 sg. with pres. sense, elided (οἶσθ’ = οἶσθα): ’you know’
οἷος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg. · rough-breathed οἷος is relative ’such as, of the kind that’ (οἷος Ὀδυσσεὺς ἔσκεν ’such as Odysseus was’) · also οἷος in an indirect exclamation, ’what sort of’ (οἷος κείνου θυμός ’what sort his spirit is’)
οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
οὐκί: οὐ — not; emphatic form οὐκί: ’not’ (ἦε καὶ οὐκί ’or not’)
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
παρίστατο: παρίσταμαι — stand beside, stand by; impf. 3 sg.: ‘stood by’
παραστάς: παρίστημι — stand beside; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist: ’standing beside’
πληγῇσιν: πληγή — blow, stroke; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
πλησίον: πλησίος — near, neighbouring; neut. acc. sg. as adv. πλησίον: ’near, beside’
πολλαὶ: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. pl.
πόδα: πούς — foot; also the sheet (the rope that sets a sail); masc. acc. sg.
πόντος: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. nom. sg.
σέο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σοῦ), gen. of comparison · also possessive gen., ’your (own)’ (σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ κήδεα ’your own woes’) · also gen. of concern after an exclamation: ὤ μοι ἐγὼ σέο ’alas for me, for your sake’
στόμ: στόμα — mouth; neut. acc. sg., elided (στόμ’ = στόμα)
στῆθος: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. acc. sg.
σφισι: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτοῖς): ’to/for them’
τέο: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., Homeric/Ionic gen. sg. (= Attic τίνος), with impersonal χρή: ’of what’
τηλεμάχοιο: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο, governed by ἰθύς ’straight toward’ (not by κίε) · also plain possessive gen. with a periphrasis (ἱερὴ ἲς Τηλεμάχοιο ’the might of Telemachus’, i.e. Telemachus himself) · also gen. governed by μεσσηγύς ’between’ (νηός τε καὶ αὐτοῦ Τηλεμάχοιο ’the ship and Telemachus himself’) · also plain possessive gen. with a noun: ’Telemachus’ (table)’ (Τηλεμάχοιο τράπεζαν) · also objective gen., dependent on φόνος: ’the slaying of Telemachus’
τόνδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., acc. sg. (agreeing with ἄεθλον) · also acc. sg. agreeing with ὄλεθρον: ’this destruction’
υἷος: υἱός — son; masc. gen. sg., epic υἷος (= Attic υἱοῦ), gen. with ἐνιπλησθῆναι · also gen. sg. of the person cared for, in a comparison: ’as a father for a son’ (πατὴρ ὣς κήδεαι υἷος) · also gen. absolute with ἐόντος: ’with a son living’
φάθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (φάθ’ = φάτο before rough breathing): ’so he spoke’
φέρτεροί: φέρτερος — stronger, better, superior; comparative adj. (no positive in use), masc. nom. pl., + gen. of comparison: ’stronger than’
φημὶ: φημί — say, assert, declare; pres. 1 sg.
φιλότητι: φιλότης — friendship, love, affection; fem. dat. sg.
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φυλάσσοις: φυλάσσω — guard, keep watch over; pres. opt. 2 sg.: ’you would keep’
φωνησάσης: φωνέω — raise the voice, speak aloud; aor. part. act. fem. gen. sg., genitive absolute
χαλκοῦ: χαλκός — bronze, copper; masc. gen. sg.
χλαῖνάν: χλαῖνα — a thick woollen cloak; fem. acc. sg.
χλαῖναν: χλαῖνα — cloak, mantle; fem. acc. sg.
χολωσάμενος: χολόω — anger; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having grown angry’
ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀγκυλομήτεω: ἀγκυλομήτης — of crooked cunning (exact sense uncertain); masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου), epithet of Cronus
ἀγοράων: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering, public speaking; fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ἀγορῶν)
ἀγορεύοις: ἀγορεύω — speak, declare; pres. opt. 2 sg., potential with ἄν: ’you would speak’
ἀγορῆθεν: ἀγορή — assembly, place of assembly; adv. ἀγορῆθεν, -θεν ’from’: ’from the assembly’
ἀκούσαμεν: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἠκούσαμεν), + gen.: ’we heard’
ἀμείνονα: ἀμείνων — better; comparative of ἀγαθός; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with σε
ἀντίος: ἀντίος — opposite, facing, to meet (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.
ἀπομόρξατο: ἀπομόργνυμι — wipe off; mid. wipe from oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’wiped away’
ἀρχὸν: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. acc. sg.
ἀτρέμας: ἀτρέμας — without moving, calmly, motionless; adv.
ἀτρεΐδεω: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
ἀχαιΐδες: Ἀχαιΐς — Achaean woman; fem. nom. pl.
ἀχνύμενοί: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
ἀχρεῖον: ἀχρεῖος — useless, to no purpose; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’uselessly, idly’
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl., with τινας ’whichever’; not the possessive
ἐξαίρετοι: ἐξαίρετος — picked out, choice, select; masc. nom. pl.
ἐπιμέμφεαι: ἐπιμέμφομαι — blame, find fault with (+ dat.); pres. 2 sg., epic -εαι (= Attic ἐπιμέμφῃ)
ἐσθλὰ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, staunch; neut. acc. pl.
ἐφεύροι: ἐφευρίσκω — find, come upon; aor. opt. 3 sg.
ἐῶμεν: ἐάω — allow, let be, leave alone; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us leave’
ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔκπεσε: ἐκπίπτω — fall out, fall from; aor. 3 sg., + gen. of the place
ἔξοχον: ἔξοχος — pre-eminent, beyond others; adj., neut./masc. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beyond, above’
ἔοικεν: ἔοικα — be like, seem, be fitting; perf. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is fitting’
ἔρεξεν: ῥέζω — do, work, perform; aor. 3 sg.
ἔσχ: ἔχω — have, hold; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔσχ’ = ἔσχε): ’had charge of, kept’
ἕζοντο: ἕζομαι — seat oneself, sit down; impf. 3 pl. mid.
ἕο: reflexive pron. (= ἑαυτοῦ, Attic οὗ) — himself; gen. sg. · also referring back to a feminine subject: ’of herself, of it’ (ἐκέλευσεν ἕο μνήσασθαι, of the belly, ’bids one think of it’)
ἕτερον: ἕτερος — the other (of two); masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., ’one (part)’, correlative: ἕτερον μὲν θειλόπεδον ... ἑτέρας δέ ’one part a drying-ground ... other parts’
ἠνίπαπε: ἐνίπτω — rebuke, chide; aor. 2 3 sg., epic reduplicated (ἠνίπαπον, no Attic equivalent)
ἠχῇ: ἠχή — sound, outcry, din; fem. dat. sg.
ἡδὺ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’sweetly’ · also attributive, agreeing with a neut. noun: ’sweet’ (ἡδὺ ποτόν ’sweet drink’) · also predicate, neut. nom. sg.: ’pleasant’ (οὐκ ἂν … ἡδὺ γένοιτο ζωέμεν ’it would not be pleasant to live’)
ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.) · also relative + indefinite, in the compound ἥν τινα = ἥτις (fem.): ’whatever, what’
ἰθακήσιος: Ἰθακήσιος — of Ithaca, Ithacan; masc. nom. sg.
ἴδηται: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a generalizing temporal clause: ’when he looks (them) over’ · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg. after πρίν γε, ’until’: ’until she has seen (me)’ (πρίν γ’ αὐτόν με ἴδηται) · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg. in a fear clause after μή: ’lest he see’ (μή τις ἴδηται)
ἴδοι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. opt. 3 sg., purpose after ὡς: ’might see’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. as a mild command: ’let him see’ (ἐξελθών τις ἴδοι ’let someone go out and see’)
ὀδυσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic Ὀδυσῆϊ (single σ, diaeresis; = Ὀδυσσῆϊ, Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
ὀνειδίζων: ὀνειδίζω — reproach, revile, taunt; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., + acc.: ’reproaching (my belly)’
ὀξέα: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. pl.
ὀπήδει: ὀπηδέω — accompany, attend (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, contracted -ει: ’kept company with’
ὄπα: ὄψ (gen. ὀπός) — voice; fem. acc. sg., epic ὄπα
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, in; postpositive prep. + dat., anastrophe (ὕπνῳ ὕπο = ὑπὸ ὕπνῳ): ’in (sweet sleep)’ · also as a preverb apart from its verb (tmesis): φυγὼν ὕπο = ὑποφυγών ’having escaped’ (φυγὼν ὕπο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ ’having escaped the pitiless day’) · also + gen. of agent, postpositive: Κικόνων ὕπο ’at the hands of the Cicones’ · also postpositive + gen., ’under, by the light of’ (δαΐδων ὕπο λαμπομενάων ’under flaring torches’) · also postpositive + acc., ’beneath’ (γαῖαν ὕπο ’beneath the earth’) · also postpositive + acc.: ’beneath, under’ (ἄλσος ὕπο ’beneath a grove’)
ῥέξῃ: ῥέζω — do, perform, accomplish; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’he may do’
